purpose: Refreeze the existing Ptichi Data Authority treatment/control assignment and fixed English Search query panel onto the first exact verified production snapshot after pre-deployment treatment drift, before any post-deployment outcome review.
siteSpecificRationale: The original 2026-09-09 cohort never entered observation because its exact frozen implementation ref was not verified live. Before the first later verified publication, several treatment pages changed while the English control membership and fixed query panel stayed unchanged. This revision preserves the original assignment and query panel, binds them to the exact production snapshot verified on 2026-09-13, and does not reinterpret the pre-publication baseline or any post-deployment outcome.

sourceEvidence.notes: PTI-DA-001 remains the treatment/control design source. The 2026-09-09 AWRP freeze remains immutable historical evidence. Ptichi's current operating record identifies 13b49e9a5faa9256b5bbded049caf33327abc240 as the last exact-SHA production revision verified live; later source commits are not treated as deployed.

assignmentPolicy: Treatment/control membership and the query panel are carried forward unchanged from the owner-reviewed 2026-09-09 freeze. The old freeze is not rewritten. Controls must not receive intentional Data Authority treatment during this observation window; correctness, safety and broken-link fixes are allowed only when recorded as contamination.

queryPanel.selectionBasis: The 12-query panel is carried forward verbatim from the 2026-09-09 owner-reviewed freeze. No post-deployment Search outcome was used to add, remove or rewrite a query or target entity.

measurementGate.reason: Ptichi's reviewed operating evidence records exact-SHA production parity for 13b49e9a5faa9256b5bbded049caf33327abc240. The treatment/control membership and fixed query panel were selected before post-deployment outcome review. The cohort is therefore ready for bounded observation; this does not prove indexing, ranking, citation, traffic or causality.

outcomes: Google Search impressions by treatment/control URL
relevant non-brand query coverage by treatment/control URL
unique treatment entities receiving relevant impressions
Google Search clicks and CTR with denominators
indexed/canonical state where owner reports expose it
Bing AI citations and unique cited pages where available
generative-search citation presence and persistence where observable

decisionRules.GO: At least three treatment entities receive relevant non-brand impressions from distinct query families and the movement is not explained equally by controls, while no page-quality, crawl or release-truth guardrail regresses.
decisionRules.CHANGE: Treatment pages gain impressions but query-to-page fit is poor, or useful continuation is weak; revise page value, answer shape or relationships instead of adding more URLs.
decisionRules.HOLD: Owner-side measurement is unavailable, the window is immature, exact deployment truth becomes uncertain, or safety/release truth blocks interpretation.
decisionRules.DROP: Treatment requires thin or duplicate pages, fabricated evidence, misleading structured data/freshness, or repeatedly creates crawl/index noise without useful discovery.
